sources.title: Clinical trial of a prion disease drug candidate begins enrolling participants
sources.verification: Current primary institution article read in browser, no body retained. Divalent small interfering RNA targeting PrP; PRiSM NCT07444580 initially targets symptomatic prion disease. October 16 update reports presymptomatic genetic-risk recruitment. Separate ION717 trial is not this candidate. No corresponding public card found; private duplicate check and primary-record verification pending.
sources.primary_verification: NCT07444580 official API confirms phase 1 PrP-siRNA, intrathecal divalent siRNA targeting PRNP mRNA. Registry aliases: 2439-s4, 2439-exNA, divalent siRNA 2439-exNA. Symptomatic and presymptomatic experimental arms are distinct; observational arm receives no drug. Origin structure references PMID42033217.
